Single |pvp_ranged_damage = [[File:OffensiveModifier.png|20px|Damage]]87 |pvp_ranged_firerate = [[File:Cooldown Icon.png|20px|Firerate]]0.65 |pvp_ranged_range = [[File:Range Icon.png|20px|Range]]6 |pvp_speed = 3.5 |pvp_hidden = {{Attr|Hidden|Yes}} |pvp_lead = {{Attr|Lead|Yes}} (Collision only) |pvp_flying = No }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Skeleton Knight''' is a unit spawned from the [[Necromancer]]'s Level 2 and 3 gravestones and randomly from dead enemies while the [[Necromancer's Tome (Consumable)|Necromancer's Tome]] consumable is active. It can be considered an upgrade of the [[Sword Skeleton]], owing to its higher health and damage. Similar to the [[Sword Skeleton]], if there are enemies in its range, it will stop moving and start attacking them with its sword. If there are no enemies in its range, it will wait for a while for enemies to enter it. If no enemy enters its range, it will continue walking. It can also deal damage through collision. ==Appearance== The '''Skeleton Knight''' is made entirely of white parts that resemble a skeletal humanoid. It does not have a full torso, but instead has the bone cage for it. Its head is slightly smaller than most other enemies and has two large black eyeholes. It wears a brown belt, black crown and a chestplate, which has a skull with neon blue eyes. It wields a black sword with skulls that have neon blue eyes. ==Skins== {| class="light-table pad-5 align-center" style="width:300px; margin:0 auto" ! |[[File:MageSkeletonKnight.png|175px]] |[[File:FallenSkeletonKnight.png|175px]] |[[File:DuckSkeletonKnight.png|175px]] |[[File:CreepySantaSkeletonKnight.png|175px]] |- !Skin |{{Color|Deluxe|Mage}} |{{Color|FallenMission|Fallen}} |{{Color|DuckyRevenge|Duck}} |{{Color|FinalAct|Creepy Santa}} |- !Obtained From |[[Deluxe Crate]] |[[Mission Quests]] |[[Ducky Revenge Event#Ducky Revenge Battle Pass|Ducky Revenge Premium Battle Pass]] |[[The Final Act Event#The Final Act Battle Pass|The Final Act Regular Battle Pass]] |} ==Strategy== *The '''Skeleton Knight''' is pretty useful against slow enemies with high health, like the [[Molten]] or [[Abnormal Boss]]. **However, its low range makes it ineffective against fast enemies with high health, like the [[Shock]] or [[Glitch]]. **Stalling towers such as the [[Freezer]] can allow the '''Skeleton Knight''' to attack enemies for longer, maximizing their high DPS potential (~137 DPS per unit). *The '''Skeleton Knight''' can deal full collision damage to enemies with defense, like the [[Heavy]] or [[Abnormal Boss]]. **The damage from its sword is still affected by defense. *The '''Skeleton Knight''' can be useful against hidden enemies as it has hidden detection, though it may struggle against higher health hidden enemies like the [[Shadow Boss]]. *The '''Skeleton Knight''' will struggle against any enemy with abilities that damage units because of its low health. **For example, if the [[Fallen King]] uses its ''Sword Swing'' attack, the '''Skeleton Knight''' will take significant damage and die in two slashes. ==Update History== {{scroll|text = *'''31 October 2023''' -
